turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My wife and I want to do a road trip along the coast for our anniversary. How many days should we plan?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That depends on the distance, but five to seven days usually lets you drive a few hours a day and still enjoy the stops.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're not in a hurry. We're both retired.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then take your time. Two nights in the nicest spots makes it feel like a holiday instead of a race.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should we book the hotels in advance or

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: just see where we end up?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Book the weekends and any popular towns ahead. Weekdays you can usually find something on the day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's a good balance. Anything special for an anniversary?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Pick one night with a really good dinner and a view. Mention the anniversary when you book, places often add a little surprise.
